title: SUPN: Shallow Universal Polynomial Networks for Efficient Function Approximation
abstract: arXiv:2511.21414v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Deep neural networks (DNNs) and Kolmogorov-Arnold networks (KANs) are flexible function approximators, but their accuracy can require substantial network depth, width, and trainable parameter counts. Beyond making the resulting networks less transparent, large parameter spaces can increase training cost and produce solutions that are sensitive to optimization and parameter initialization, leading to variability in generalization error. For these reasons, we propose Shallow Universal Polynomial Networks (SUPNs), which retain a single hidden layer while increasing the expressivity of each unit through a learnable multivariate polynomial inside each activation, which we refer to as a polynomial pre-activation. This construction trades architectural depth and width for greater expressivity within each hidden unit, reducing parameter counts and training cost while preserving a shallow computational graph. translated_title: SUPN：用于高效函数逼近的浅层通用多项式网络
translated_abstract: 深度神经网络（DNN）和Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN）是灵活的函数逼近器，但其精度往往需要较大的网络深度、宽度和可训练参数量。这不仅使所得网络缺乏透明度，庞大的参数空间还会增加训练成本，并产生对优化过程和参数初始化敏感的解，从而导致泛化误差的不稳定性。基于这些原因，我们提出了浅层通用多项式网络（SUPNs），它在保留单个隐藏层的同时，通过在每个激活函数内部嵌入一个可学习的多元多项式（我们称之为多项式预激活）来提高每个单元的表达能力。这种构造以架构的深度和宽度换取每个隐藏单元内部更强的表达能力，在保持浅层计算图的同时，降低了参数数量和训练成本。我们建立了两个互补的通用逼近理论……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出浅层通用多项式网络（SUPN），通过在每个激活函数内部嵌入可学习的多元多项式（多项式预激活），以单个隐藏层实现更强的表达能力，用更少的参数和更低的训练成本完成高效函数逼近。
en_tdlr: We propose Shallow Universal Polynomial Networks (SUPNs), which boost the expressivity of a single hidden layer by embedding a learnable multivariate polynomial (polynomial pre-activation) inside each activation, achieving efficient function approximation with fewer parameters and lower training cost.
